title: Knights of Sidonia
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A thousand years after alien Gauna destroyed the solar system, the seed ship Sidonia carries the last humans, some of whom photosynthesize, are cloned or belong to a third gender. Nagate Tanikaze, raised alone in the ship's underground, emerges to become a pilot of the Guardian mecha that defend Sidonia. Tsutomu Nihei's space opera follows a hopeless war, the losses of young pilots and the secrets of the ship's immortal ruling council.
life_message: Courage, duty to one's community and loyalty to comrades give life meaning even in a war that may not be winnable.
